defects.claim: The Manager now keeps its pending entry on a plain write error, but the poll path never retries the write
defects.evidence: checkApproval deletes `h.pending[requestID]` (github.go:407), calls `pending.CancelFn()` (github.go:412) and then calls resolvePending (github.go:150-170), which logs the error, delivers the response and closes the channel. No poll tick is left to retry, so the "retry on next poll tick" intent holds only for non-poll callers.

defects.claim: The rehydrated test replaces `p.CancelFn` without holding `h.mu`, while the poll goroutine started by Rehydrate is still alive. This is a latent data race under `-race`, though the one-hour poll interval makes a hit unlikely.
